title: Pause the agent with Hold
done: That is it: the agent stops after the step it is on, and nothing is lost.

steps.caption: Now shows what the agent is doing: here, running the parser's tests.
Hold asks the agent to stop after the step it is on. It never cuts a step short.
Press it, and Hold stays lit until you release it.
Press it again to release it: the work goes on where it stopped.
Your turn: press Hold on the demo.
